title: Home guide: the law of reflection
subject: Science
source: Written for science/y8 lesson 21 (Home practical guide and safety card: mirror and torch (portal worksheet; never shine light in eyes, tape mirror edges))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Show that the angle of incidence equals the angle of reflection.
equipment: A torch with card and tape over it to make a narrow beam
safety: Never shine light into anyone's eyes
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Stand the mirror upright on the line on the practical sheet.
Shine a narrow beam along the 20° incident line.
Mark the reflected ray with two dots and join them.
Measure the angle of reflection from the normal.
